snippet.description:
Geodesics in Calculus of Variations, Euler-Lagrange equation solved examples, and finding extremals of functionals for MSc Maths, CSIR NET, and GATE Mathematics.

Namaste learners! Iss lecture mein hum Calculus of Variations ke important problems ko step-by-step solve karenge using the Euler-Lagrange Differential Equation and Beltrami Identity. 

Agar aap M.Sc. Mathematics, B.Sc. Maths, ya CSIR NET / GATE exam ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh yeh lecture aapke liye kaafi helpful rahega. Isme humne cover kiya hai:
1. Extremals of Functionals find karna
2. Geodesic on a Right Circular Cylinder find karna aur proof karna ki yeh ek Circular Helix hoti hai
3. Polar Coordinates mein shortest distance / straight line derive karna (theta vs r as independent variables)
4. Coordinate transformation (Polar to Cartesian) use karke functional ko extremize karna

📌 Timestamps:
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Brachistochrone Problem
01:56 - Example 3: Finding Extremals of a Functional
09:30 - Example 4: Geodesics on a Right Circular Cylinder
23:38 - Example 5: Shortest Path in Polar Coordinates (Straight Line)
37:39 - Example 6: Extremals using Coordinate Transformation
48:03 - Conclusion & Next Lecture Preview

Agar aapko lecture pasand aaye toh video ko LIKE karein, dosto ke sath SHARE karein, aur Fractal Frontier Maths ko SUBSCRIBE karna na bhoolein! 

Koi bhi doubt ho toh comment section mein zaroor poochiye. Keep learning, keep exploring!
